description: Three-restriction search over a mixed-extension directory: extension filter, negation, and occurrence count. The target shape is the grep tool (include=*.go, invert/files_only) plus one narrow count pass; bash-grep is the anti-pattern this case exists to measure. record_only until the grep-tool extension lands — at that point flip to min_pass_rate 0.6 and bind max_bash_grep_calls as a gate.
